key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.0s): Initial archival pose of cow; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.12s): Mid-sequence articulation of cow; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.36s): Peak dynamic extension of cow over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.6s): Follow-through and settle of cow with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of cow (2.0s..5.6s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.

design_selection.method: SCION + Zero-Shot Quick, Draw! Prototype Matcher (top-25 recognized human drawings)
